question: Welche Kundenkonten haben ihren Monatsumsatz vom ersten zum letzten aktiven Monat am staerksten gesteigert (mindestens 5 Bestellungen insgesamt)?
generated_sql:
WITH MonthlyRevenue AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id, 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS month, 
        SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity) AS revenue
    FROM 
        public.orders o
    JOIN 
        public.order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
    GROUP BY 
        o.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)
),
CustomerGrowth AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(month) AS first_month,
        MAX(month) AS last_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS active_months
    FROM 
        MonthlyRevenue
    GROUP BY 
        customer_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT month) >= 5
),
RevenueComparison AS (
    SELECT 
        mr.customer_id,
        cg.first_month,
        cg.last_month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN mr.month = cg.first_month THEN mr.revenue ELSE 0 END) AS first_month_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN mr.month = cg.last_month THEN mr.revenue ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_revenue
    FROM 
        MonthlyRevenue mr
    JOIN 
        CustomerGrowth cg ON mr.customer_id = cg.customer_id
    GROUP BY 
        mr.customer_id, cg.first_month, cg.last_month
)
SELECT 
    rc.customer_id, 
    cu.company_name, 
    rc.first_month_revenue, 
    rc.last_month_revenue, 
    rc.last_month_revenue - rc.first_month_revenue AS revenue_growth
FROM 
    RevenueComparison rc
JOIN 
    public.customers cu ON rc.customer_id = cu.customer_id
ORDER BY 
    revenue_growth DESC
LIMIT 10;
response_preview:

question: Welche Produktpaare aus unterschiedlichen Kategorien werden ueberproportional oft gemeinsam gekauft (Lift gegenueber Unabhaengigkeit)?
generated_sql:
WITH product_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        p1.category_id AS category1, 
        p2.category_id AS category2, 
        COUNT(*) AS pair_count
    FROM public.order_details od1
    JOIN public.order_details od2 ON od1.order_id = od2.order_id AND od1.product_id < od2.product_id
    JOIN public.products p1 ON od1.product_id = p1.product_id
    JOIN public.products p2 ON od2.product_id = p2.product_id
    WHERE p1.category_id <> p2.category_id
    GROUP BY p1.category_id, p2.category_id
),
category_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        p.category_id, 
        COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM public.order_details od
    JOIN public.products p ON od.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.category_id
),
lift_values AS (
    SELECT 
        pp.category1, 
        pp.category2, 
        pp.pair_count, 
        ct1.total_count AS total1, 
        ct2.total_count AS total2,
        (pp.pair_count::float / (ct1.total_count * ct2.total_count)) AS lift
    FROM product_pairs pp
    JOIN category_totals ct1 ON pp.category1 = ct1.category_id
    JOIN category_totals ct2 ON pp.category2 = ct2.category_id
)
SELECT category1, category2, lift
FROM lift_values
ORDER BY lift DESC
LIMIT 5;
response_preview:
